_comment: Reel scripts. `text` is what is on screen; `vo` is what the voice says (spelled for the TTS: 'P G vector', 'L L M'). Every claim comes from the site's own data: comparisons.ts, symptoms.ts and data.ts. Timing is not written here: voice.py measures each spoken line and lays the beats out to fit it.

beats.text: Your RAG app probably doesn't need a vector database.
beats.vo: Your RAG app probably doesn't need a vector database.

beats.text: Most teams add one before checking if Postgres can do the job.
beats.vo: Most teams add one before checking if Postgres can already do the job.

beats.text: Filtering by users or permissions?
beats.sub: A SQL join beats a copy you keep in sync.
beats.vo: Filtering by users or permissions? A join beats a copy you have to keep in sync.

beats.text: Under a few million vectors?
beats.sub: pgvector handles it. No new service to run.
beats.vo: Under a few million vectors? P G vector handles it, with no new service to run.

beats.text: Bad search results?
beats.sub: Usually chunking or embeddings. Not the database.
beats.vo: Bad results are usually chunking or embeddings. Not the database.

beats.label: The call
beats.text: Start on pgvector. Move to Qdrant or Pinecone when vector search becomes the workload.
beats.vo: Start on P G vector. Move to Quadrant or Pinecone when vector search becomes the workload.

beats.text: Full comparison
beats.vo: The full comparison is on Lattice. Link in bio.

beats.text: Your LLM app is slow. It's probably not the model.
beats.vo: Your L L M app is slow. It's probably not the model.

beats.text: Check these five. In this order.
beats.vo: Check these five, in this order.

beats.text: Trace one slow request end to end
beats.sub: You can't shorten a span you haven't seen.
beats.vo: One. Trace one slow request, end to end.

beats.text: Count the output tokens. Ask for fewer.
beats.sub: Often the largest single win, and free to try.
beats.vo: Two. Count the output tokens, and ask for fewer.

beats.text: Run independent calls in parallel
beats.vo: Three. Run independent calls in parallel.

beats.text: Cache repeats. Add a faster fallback.
beats.sub: A repeated prompt should never reach a model.
beats.vo: Four. Cache repeated prompts, and add a faster fallback.

beats.text: Only then, tune the serving runtime
beats.sub: The most expensive place to look first.
beats.vo: Five. Only then, tune the serving runtime.

beats.label: Not the fix
beats.text: Buying a bigger GPU before measuring where the time goes.
beats.vo: Not the fix: buying a bigger G P U before you've measured where the time goes.

beats.text: The full checklist
beats.vo: The full checklist is on Lattice. Link in bio.

beats.text: Cutting your LLM bill? Do it in this order.
beats.vo: Cutting your L L M bill? Do it in this order.

beats.text: Spend is never even. A few features, long prompts or silent retries dominate it.
beats.vo: Spend is never even. A few features, long prompts, or silent retries usually dominate it.

beats.text: Attribute spend per feature
beats.sub: The only cut with zero quality risk.
beats.vo: One. Attribute spend per request and feature.

beats.text: Shrink the prompt and context
beats.sub: Input tokens are paid on every call.
beats.vo: Two. Shrink the prompt, and the context you send.

beats.text: Cache repeats. Enforce budgets.
beats.sub: A cache hit is a call you don't pay for.
beats.vo: Three. Cache repeats, and enforce budgets at the gateway.

beats.text: Route easy queries to cheaper models
beats.sub: With an eval first: it trades quality for cost.
beats.vo: Four. Route easy queries to a cheaper model. With an eval first.

beats.text: Self-host last
beats.sub: Only when utilisation is high and steady.
beats.vo: Five. Self host last, and only when utilisation is high and steady.

beats.text: Every step, with tools
beats.vo: Every step, with the tools for it, is on Lattice. Link in bio.

beats.text: Every AI app runs on the same nine layers.
beats.vo: Every A I app runs on the same nine layers.
Inference. Routing. Retrieval. Training. Agents. Workflows. Guardrails. Prompts. And evals.

beats.text: 112 tools, sorted by the layer they live in.
beats.vo: Lattice sorts a hundred and twelve tools by the layer they live in.

beats.text: And every one tells you when to skip it.
beats.vo: And every one tells you when to skip it.

beats.text: Find your layer
beats.vo: Find your layer. Link in bio.

beats.text: Stop picking agent frameworks by GitHub stars.
beats.vo: Stop picking agent frameworks by GitHub stars.

beats.text: Pick by the shape of the job.
beats.vo: Pick by the shape of the job.

beats.text: Retrieval is the product
beats.vo: Retrieval is the product? Llama Index.

beats.text: Tool calls must be schema-safe
beats.vo: Tool calls must be schema safe? Pydantic A I.

beats.text: A small loop with handoffs
beats.vo: A small loop with handoffs built in? The Open A I Agents S D K.

beats.text: The widest integrations
beats.sub: → LangChain, and pay the abstraction tax
beats.vo: The widest integrations? Lang Chain. And you'll pay the abstraction tax.

beats.label: Either way
beats.text: Run the loop on a durable host and trace every tool call.
beats.vo: Either way, run the loop on a durable host, and trace every tool call.

beats.vo: The full comparison is on Lattice. Link in bio.
